pages.title: Zootopia Judy Hopps Completing an Obstacle Course at the Police Academy Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Judy Hopps completing a police academy obstacle course in Zootopia, lifting one leg over a low hurdle in her training uniform. A shield badge and striped pants detail her outfit, while a climbing net, balance logs, and a sloped wall add varied structures around the rabbit.

pages.title: Zootopia Nick Wilde Wearing His Hawaiian Shirt and Sunglasses on a City Sidewalk Coloring Page
pages.description: Nick Wilde wears his Hawaiian shirt and sunglasses on a city sidewalk in this printable coloring page, with both paws tucked into his trouser pockets beneath the tie. Flower and leaf patterns cover the shirt, while a striped tie, bushy tail, storefront awning, and tall streetlamp add detail to the Zootopia scene.

pages.title: Zootopia Nick Wilde Carrying a Jumbo Popsicle Outside Jumbeaux's Cafe Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Nick Wilde carrying a jumbo popsicle outside Jumbeaux's Cafe, wearing a floral shirt and striped tie beneath his pointed fox ears. The oversized treat has long molded grooves and melting drips, while the cafe's elephant-shaped entrance and cherry-topped decoration provide smaller background sections.

pages.title: Zootopia Young Nick Wilde Wearing His Junior Ranger Scout Uniform Coloring Page
pages.description: Young Nick Wilde wears his Junior Ranger Scout uniform in this printable coloring page, standing with paws on his hips beneath a hat bearing a tree badge. A neckerchief, buttoned shirt pockets, belted shorts, and sleeve patch divide the outfit, while his large ears and bushy tail offer broader enclosed coloring areas.

pages.title: Zootopia Finnick Wearing His Baby Elephant Disguise Inside Jumbeaux's Cafe Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Finnick in his baby elephant disguise inside Jumbeaux's Cafe, with oversized costume ears and an upturned trunk above his exposed face. Rounded mitten toes, a front zipper, and a small tail detail the suit, while cafe chairs, floor tiles, and a cupcake display frame the Zootopia scene.

pages.title: Zootopia Finnick Holding His Sunglasses Beside His Van Coloring Page
pages.description: Finnick holds his sunglasses beside his van in this printable coloring page, with large upright ears, an open hooded jacket, and cargo shorts above his small paws. The glasses' broad lenses contrast with smaller jacket folds and pocket details, while the van's door, mirror, and wheels form a simple background.

pages.title: Zootopia Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde Riding the Gondola in the Rainforest District Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde riding a gondola in Zootopia's Rainforest District, seated together beside a wide window overlooking the trees. Other cable cars cross above a waterfall and elevated walkway, while Judy's knee pads, Nick's striped tie, and the cabin frame add smaller outlined details.

pages.title: Zootopia Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde Confronting Bellwether in the Museum Coloring Page
pages.description: Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde confront Bellwether in the museum in this printable coloring page, facing the bespectacled sheep beside a roped-off mammoth skeleton display. Judy rests her paws on her hips as Bellwether clasps her hands, while Nick's striped tie, stone columns, and floor tiles provide additional coloring sections.

pages.title: Zootopia Officer Clawhauser Holding a Donut at the Reception Desk Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Officer Clawhauser holding a donut at the Zootopia reception desk, smiling above his police shirt, tie, badge, and shoulder radio. Sprinkles and icing divide the donut into small shapes, while outlined fur spots, shirt pockets, and the desk monitor add detail around the broad character contours.

pages.title: Zootopia Gazelle Singing Into a Microphone on Stage Coloring Page
pages.description: Gazelle sings into a microphone on stage in this printable coloring page, with curved ridged horns, side-swept hair, and a beaded performance outfit beneath two spotlights. Small costume circles and the microphone's mesh head provide fine sections, while the long limbs, broad light beams, and curved stage create larger coloring areas.

pages.title: Zootopia Wolf Guards Howling Together Outside Cliffside Asylum Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows two wolf guards howling together outside Cliffside Asylum, lifting their noses above uniform shirts with badges, shoulder radios, and utility belts. Fur tufts, belt pouches, and shirt pockets add smaller details, while the asylum's high entrance, winding approach, and steep rocky cliffs frame the Zootopia scene.

pages.title: Zootopia Mayor Lionheart Giving a Speech at a Podium Coloring Page
pages.description: Mayor Lionheart gives a speech at a podium in this printable coloring page, raising one paw beside a curved microphone while wearing a suit and tie. His layered mane, lapel pin, and small sleeve buttons add finer details, while the podium's broad front and the domed building behind him provide larger sections.

pages.title: Zootopia Bellwether Carrying a Stack of Books at City Hall Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Bellwether carrying a stack of books at City Hall, with large glasses, a curled woolly forelock, and a jacket over her skirt. Three thick volumes offer broad covers and narrow page edges to color, while a paneled doorway and potted plant complete the Zootopia setting.

pages.title: Zootopia Mr. Big Attending Fru Fru's Wedding in His Tuxedo Coloring Page
pages.description: Mr. Big attends Fru Fru's wedding in his tuxedo in this printable coloring page, seated in a studded armchair with one paw resting on a cane. A bow tie, waistcoat, pocket square, and rose boutonniere detail his outfit, while flower-tied curtains and scattered petals frame the Zootopia character.

pages.title: Zootopia Duke Weaselton Selling Bootleg Dvds at His Street Stall Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Duke Weaselton selling bootleg DVDs at his street stall, holding up a case beneath a large umbrella while grinning broadly. Rows of blank covers and stacked cases create repeated rectangular sections around his pointed muzzle, open shirt, whiskers, and long curved tail on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Zootopia 2 Mayor Brian Winddancer Speaking at a Podium Coloring Page
pages.description: Mayor Brian Winddancer speaks at a podium in this Zootopia 2 printable coloring page, raising one hoof beside two microphones while wearing a three-piece suit. His swept mane, long tail, tie, and pocket square add distinct details, with broad jacket and podium panels set against a mostly open background.

pages.title: Zootopia 2 Dr. Fuzzby Standing Beside Her Projector Screen Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dr. Fuzzby beside her projector screen in Zootopia 2, gesturing with an open paw while wearing large round glasses and a pendant. The blank screen provides a broad open area behind her, while the projector lens, table legs, cardigan pockets, and tripod supports add smaller outlined sections.
